Method of Attack: Distributed via spam emails with ZIP attachments containing VBS downloader script
Downloader script downloads Locky ransomware executable to %Temp% folder and executes it
Encrypts files on infected computer appending .diablo6 extension with specific filename format
Displays ransom note diablo6-[random].htm with payment instructions
Impacted Systems: Windows computers (implied by %Temp% folder and Shadow Volume Copies)
Attack Vector: Spam emails with ZIP attachments containing VBS downloader script
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with .diablo6 extension and filename format like E87091F1-D24A-922B-00F6B112-72BB7EA6EADF.diablo6
Spam email subjects like E [date] (random_number).docx, e.g. E 2017-08-09 (698).docx
Ransom payment site demanding 0.49 BTC (~$1,600 USD)
